product.description: The Pawsome SlickBrush 3-Piece set delivers a gentle yet effective grooming experience for dogs of all sizes. Each brush features a blend of soft silicone bristles and a firmer nylon core to remove loose hair, detangle mats, and smooth coat texture. The ergonomic handle offers a comfortable grip, while the lightweight construction keeps the set easy to carry during walks or grooming sessions. Designed for daily use, the brushes are dishwasher‑safe for quick cleanup and come in a vibrant red finish that stands out in any pet care kit.
